results.title: The user's live test: buttock pain after cold tiles and low mood; doctor prescribes nasal spray, patient asks if it goes in the butt, doctor claims a high temperature never measured

turns.english: I sat on a cold tile and probably chilled my butt.
And also my heart feels somehow cold, I think I have no mood at all.
I think it should be your nose. I'm gonna give you nasal sprays every day for the next three weeks after lunch and after dinner.
turns.translation: Я думаю, это должно быть ваш нос. Я буду давать вам назальные спреи каждый день в течение следующих трёх недель после обеда и после ужина.

turns.english: And why do I need this? Do I have to spray it in my butt?
You are not cold, you are very hot and have a really high temperature.
turns.translation: Вы не замерзаете, у вас очень жарко и температура действительно высокая.

cards_live.body: Need to rule out infection, fracture, or nerve problems that need urgent care.
cards_live.ask_text: Do you have any fever, recent injury, or numbness or weakness in your legs?

cards_live.body: The patient reports feeling very low mood and a cold feeling in the heart, which may indicate depression; you should screen for suicidal thoughts now.
cards_live.ask_text: In the past few weeks, have you had thoughts of hurting yourself or that life isn’t worth living?

cards_live.title: Plan mismatched to complaint
cards_live.body: Doctor prescribed a nasal spray for buttock pain despite no nasal symptoms or examination, which is inconsistent and may confuse the patient.

cards_live.title: Patient confused about spray location
cards_live.body: Patient wonders if the nasal spray should be applied to the butt, indicating the prescribed treatment does not match the complaint.

cards_live.title: Temperature not measured
cards_live.body: Doctor states the patient has a very high temperature, but no temperature measurement is recorded in the visit.

advice.en: Use nasal spray after lunch and dinner daily.
advice.native: Используйте назальный спрей после обеда и ужина ежедневно.
